main_text.p: ex assūptis potulentis, aut ulcere partiū, per quas transit) signumq; est malum in morbis acutis ; nisi forsan die critico urina copiosè excernatur.

Omnis urinę color, est ex admistione alieni humoris; bilis scilicet aut alterius succi; nam sola coctio, aut alteratio urinā non tingit. proinde flava sanorum urina, est ex admistione bilis naturalis serum imbuentis & tingentis. Quāto itaq; urina candidior, tanto minus inest bilis; cruditateq; indicat, aut obstructiones: nisi forsam alio ut in caput, rapiatur; quemadmodū in Phrenitide & febribus ardētibus fieri amat; proinde malū est signum. Ita in lętero urina alba diu perseverans hydropē minatur. Vrina alba, crassaq; significat pituitæ copiam. Vrina pinguis, phtisin & colliquationem pinguedinis. Vrina subspicea meliorem concoctionem indicat, quam subalba. Quanto bilis, quā tingitur, urina, intensiorem habet calorē ; tanto majorem viscerum ardorem arguit. page.notes: The right margin carries marginal notes in very small type, cut off by the edge of the scan and too faint to read; they are not transcribed. Doubtful: "alio" (line ending "forsam alio") and "ut" are read as printed; "lętero" as printed. The catchword "di &" is taken from the foot of the last line.
